Name: Canon EOS R5 Mirrorless Camera Body
Description: The Canon EOS R5 is a full frame mirrorless camera thats powered with a large 45MP CMOS Image Sensor and a powerful DIGIC X Image Processor. Description: The Tamron 17-70mm f/2.8 Di III-A VC RXD Lens is a versatile zoom lens that's designed for Sony E-mount APS-C mirrorless cameras to capture really sharp and stunning image quality. Being versatile makes it the ideal lens for everyday photography, and with this comes exceptional image performance throughout the entire zoom range.Key features to achieving a powerful performance and spectacular image quality is all thanks to advanced glass elements that's been incorporated into this lightweight construction. Name: Sony FE 70-200mm f/2.8 GM OSS II Lens
Description: The Sony FE 70-200mm f/2.8 GM OSS II is a telephoto zoom lens designed for professionals. This Sony G Master Series Mark II lens builds on the success of its predecessor, while lighter, it features improvements in all other areas.The optical design delivers increased sharpness with a minimum of aberrations, that include an XA element, an aspherical element, two extra-low dispersion aspherical elements, two extra-low dispersion elements, and two Super ED elements.To assist the Sony FE 70-200mm f/2.8 GM OSS II Lens in reducing reflections, flare, and ghosting for improved contrast and colour the optical design also features Sony's latest Nano AR II Coating.For fast, precise, and highly responsive autofocus for stationary subjects the Sony FE 70-200mm f/2.8 GM OSS II Lens features four XD Linear motors, with two motors driving each of the internal focusing groups. The floating focus design divides the elements into two independently controlled groups for increased responsiveness, for both still and video applications, with speeds up to four times faster than its previous version design.For effective use in low-light conditions, as well as greater control over shallow depth of field the Sony FE 70-200mm f/2.8 GM OSS II Lens is optimized for speed while maintaining a fast and constant f/2.8 aperture.Smooth bokeh is achieved by the eleven-blade circular diaphragm for smooth out-of-focus areas. For use in video applications, the improved aperture drive unit provides a fast yet quiet operation and is combined with an aperture ring that has switchable on/off cliks and iris lock.

Name: DJI Mic 3 2-Person Compact Digital Wireless Microphone System/Recorder for Camera and Smartphone (2.4 GHz)
Description:
The DJI Mic 3 2-Person Compact Digital Wireless Microphone System/Recorder for Camera and Smartphone (2.4 GHz) is the third iteration in the DJI Microphone lineup, with a number of updates from the predecessor.
The DJI Mic 3 Transmitter is compact and lightweight, with both magnetic and clip-on options for attachment to your talent, making discreet placement easy. The included charging case can neatly hold one receiver along with two transmitters with their windscreens, and either the magnet or magnetic clip attached.
The DJI Mic 3 2-Person Compact Digital Wireless Microphone System/Recorder for Camera and Smartphone (2.4 GHz) offers two modes for balanced volume using adaptive gain control. Automatic Mode prevents audio clipping, ideal for outdoor environments, while Dynamic Mode adjust gain control in response to volume changes, ideal for indoor/studio environments. Furthermore, you will also find voice tone presets to match your style, two cancelling settings for focused sound.
Your DJI Mic 3 Receiver allows for both Mono and Stereo (dual-channel) audio recording modes. Output from the transmitters can be recorded as separate streams, or both can be merged into a single track to suit any creative scenario.
Robust anti-interference capabilities ensure stable audio transmission in complex environments. With support for automatic frequency hopping between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands and you will appreciate the transmission range of up to 400 meters. With Lossless Audio enabled, the transmitter delivers uncompressed 48kHz 24-bit audio directly to the receiver. This ensures every recording is captured in stunning, high-fidelity detail.
Internal recording, featured on the DJI Mic 3 2-Person Compact Digital Wireless Microphone System/Recorder for Camera and Smartphone, protects your files from wireless interference or device failures. Both the original track and algorithm-enhanced versions are recorded at once. Furthermore, 32-bit float internal recording is also offered, which not only delivers high-quality recordings but also adapts better to complex sound environments.

Name: DJI Mic Mini 2S Two-Person Compact Wireless Microphone System for Camera and Smartphone
Description:
The DJI Mic Mini 2S Two-Person Compact Wireless Microphone System for Camera and Smartphone now features 32-bit float to ensure your audio is kept secure for easy recovery in post without clipping or loss.
Both transmitters feature approximately 14.5GB of internal storage that offers about 28 hours of loop internal 24-bit storage. You can set your transmitters to record internally upon startup, or to sync to the receiver.
For fast transfer speeds of up to 34 MB/s (30 minutes of 24-bit audio transfers in about 8 seconds). Simply connect your charging case with the transmitters in it to a computer or smartphone for transfers.
Two-level AI noise cancelling built into the DJI Mic Mini 2 S is powered by DJI's new proprietary noise-cancelling AI model. Choose between either the Strong or Basic modes to suppress ambient noise for crystal clear audio. In the box, you will also find windscreens to attach to the transmitters to effectively reduce wind noise, or other unwanted noise from entering the microphone capsule.
The Mini 2 S offers levels of adaptive gain control, providing Clipping Control to reduce sudden spikes to preserve audio quality in volatile environments such as racetracks. Then Loudness Balance dynamically adjust gain to stabilise volume for interviews and live streams.
The transmitter, weighing just about 12g, easily mounts to your talent via magnetic clips to function as an unobtrusive lavalier microphone. The clip is fully rotatable for easy positioning in any direction for optimal audio alignment.
A single DJI Mic Mini 2S Receiver can be paired with up to four transmitters simultaneously. This makes it ideal for podcasts and commercial shoots. For a cost-effective setup, Mic Mini, Mic Mini 2, and Mic Mini 2S transmitters and receivers support mix and match. Mic Mini 2S transmitters also connect directly to the Mic Series Mobile Receiver.
The Mini 2S transmitter features Mono, Stereo, and Quadraphonic modes for diverse audio routing. Safety track can also be recorded in the DJI Mimo App for a backup at -6dB to prevent issues such as clipping and distortion.
Using the DJI Mimo app, the transmitters automatically connect to the smartphone for recording or live stream apps. Instant Reconnection is made possible where the transmitters store pairing data for up to two receivers and one compatible Osmo camera. This means that devices reconnect automatically after the initial pairing.
With the Mic Mini 2 S transmitter connected to the 2S receiver, your transmission distances can reach up to 400 meters. 
On a single full charge, the transmitters may last up to 11 hours, and the receiver up to 10 hours before a recharge is needed. With the charging case fully charged, you can expect up to 3.2 full charges before the case needs a charge. This allows for up to 40 hours of extended use.
